name: Nicholas and Company Salt Lake City
old_description: Since 1939, Nicholas and Company has supplied restaurants, fed families, and supported employees in the Greek tradition of Philotimo. We have built our foundation on a commitment to honorably serve the communities we live and work in, both for today and for future generations.
about:
Nicholas and Company operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1939 by Nicholas Mouskondis. The business remains family-owned, now led by the fourth generation of the Mouskondis family, and conducts its operations according to the Greek principle of philotimo — a commitment to honorable service to customers, employees, and the community.

The company functions as a broadline foodservice distributor across six territories in the Intermountain West. It maintains 16.7 million square feet of temperature-controlled warehouse space and stocks more than 14,000 unique products, ranging from fresh produce and center-of-plate proteins to canned goods, beverages, non-food supplies, and flowers. A fleet of over 100 climate-controlled tractors and trailers, equipped with scan-based picking and delivery tracking, supports daily distribution to customer sites.

Customers include independently owned restaurants, regional and national chains, healthcare facilities, government agencies, and educational institutions. The company fields dedicated teams for healthcare nutrition compliance, government and education procurement regulations, and chain-restaurant consistency programs. It also provides access to 1,800-plus Markon produce items, next-day specialty meat and fish kits, and more than 20 exclusive private-label brands.

Leadership emphasizes that family ownership enables agility and long-term stability compared with larger corporate distributors. The firm reinvests in community food donations, recycling initiatives, and local events, framing its scale and service breadth as tools to sustain the regional food ecosystem rather than merely to expand market share.
